name: dmcheck
description: Deterministic conduct verdicts for live tabletop sessions. Input: a strict UTF-8 transcript with optional source identity/correlation, an optional engine ledger, and a versioned table charter. Output: a typed EvaluationResult whose findings carry stable identity, effective policy, provenance, and redacted evidence. Ambiguity is never promoted to a definite accusation; unusable evidence fails closed.
install: UNRELEASED 0.6.0 candidate: install this checkout with `pip install .`; use `pip install dmcheck` only after 0.6.0 is published

commands.dmcheck run <transcript> --gm <name> [--: referee or exactly replay the session; findings as JSON
commands.dmcheck watch <transcript> --gm <name> [: follow transcript and ledger JSONL; emit stable finding lifecycle and source-health events
commands.dmcheck rules: the active rule set plus the retired R5 compatibility id, with definitions

lifecycle: Each finding has a deterministic finding_id. session_end returns the typed closed evaluation plus incomplete obligations and source coverage.

mcp.release_status: unreleased 0.6.0 candidate; public 0.5.5 predates this contract
mcp.path_policy: denied unless beneath DMCHECK_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS or --allow-root with secure component-relative no-follow opens; unsupported platforms fail closed

boundaries: Table conduct and communication only: never action legality. srdcheck is advisory; authorized upstream state plus the DM/table decide. No character math (charactercheck), narrative-quality judging, or model calls anywhere.
